notes.title: Minor updates
notes.content:
Improvement of translation accuracy.
Fixes to the options screen.
Bug Fixes.

notes.title: Sale to commemorate a major update!
notes.content:
An illustrated book function has been added.
This allows users to view detailed data on towers and monsters.
Added loading screen.
Added spelling explanations.
Balance adjustments have been made.

notes.title: Third major update!
notes.content:
An illustrated book function has been added.
This allows users to view detailed data on towers and monsters.
Added loading screen.
Added spelling explanations.
Balance adjustments have been made.

notes.title: Major update! Support for Steam achievements!
notes.content:
Added long-awaited Steam Achievements.
Magic enhancement has been added. Four types of spells (fire, ice, lightning, and summon) can be enhanced through seven levels.
Battle balance has been adjusted. It is now easier to play.

notes.title: Major Update. Magic implemented!
notes.content:
Finally, magic implemented!
Luna the Black Cat will assist you with powerful magic.
There are four types of magic that will be available.
Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Summoning.
Summon the griffons to fight!

notes.title: Balance adjustment implemented.
notes.content:
More towers available in the early stages.
Simplified the tutorial.
Adjusted the balance of the early stages.
